The Ring-givers' faith is practiced through artifice. Each accomplishment or blessing is added to their collection of charms, rings and baubles. Nantosuelta is known as the Queen of Bells (by those who build temples to her), Keymaker (by the tinkerers who practice the most intricate and arcane of her artifice) and the Mother of Knights (by warriors that rely only on their skills, weapon and her charms to protect themselves)
		
		[PARAGRAPH:2]State religion allows access to:[PARAGRAPH:1][TAB][LINK=UNIT_MITHRIL_GOLEM]The Mithril Golem[\LINK] (world unit and summon)[PARAGRAPH:1][TAB][LINK=UNIT_PRIEST_RINGGIVER]Artificer [\LINK] (unit)[PARAGRAPH:1][TAB][LINK=UNIT_HIGH_PRIEST_RINGGIVER]Instructor [\LINK] (unit)[PARAGRAPH:1][TAB][LINK=UNIT_TANK]Tank [\LINK] (unit)[PARAGRAPH:1][TAB]Halves the production cost of: [PARAGRAPH:1][TAB][LINK=BUILDING_GUILD_OF_HAMMERS]The Guild of Endeavors[\LINK] [PARAGRAPH:1][TAB][LINK=BUILDING_SCULPTORS_STUDIO]Scultors' Studio[\LINK] [PARAGRAPH:1][TAB][LINK=BUILDING_ADULARIA_CHAMBER]Adularia Chamber[\LINK] [PARAGRAPH:1][TAB][LINK=BUILDING_BLASTING_WORKSHOP]Blasting Workshop[\LINK][PARAGRAPH:1][TAB][LINK=BUILDING_GOLEM_TRACKS]Golem Tracks[\LINK][PARAGRAPH:1][TAB][LINK=BUILDING_PALLENS_ENGINE]Pallens Engine[\LINK] [PARAGRAPH:1][TAB][LINK=BUILDING_FORM_OF_THE_TITAN]Form of the Titan[\LINK] [PARAGRAPH:1][TAB][LINK=BUILDING_PALACE_LUCHUIRP]The Luchuirp Palace[\LINK] [PARAGRAPH:2]Units of this faith are more likely to gain affinity for [LINK=BONUS_MANA_ENCHANTMENT]Enchantment[\LINK] mana
		
[PARAGRAPH:3]Priests and Angels of [LINK=RELIGION_RINGGIVER]The Ringgivers[\LINK] will have their ardas most strengthened by the influence of [LINK=RELIGION_RINGGIVER]The Ringgivers[\LINK], but also strengthened to a lesser degree by [LINK=RELIGION_THE_EMPYREAN]The Order[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_HOUSE_OF_PLENTY]The House of Plenty[\LINK], The [LINK=RELIGION_RUNES_OF_KILMORPH]The Runes of Kilmorph[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_UNBLEMISHED]The Unblemished[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_THE_EMPYREAN]The Empyrean[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_BROTHERHOOD_OF_WARDENS]The Brotherhood of Wardens[\LINK], and [LINK=RELIGION_LAERAN_CORD]The Laeran Cord[\LINK]. Its arda will be weakened by [LINK=RELIGION_CHILDREN_OF_THE_ONE]The Children of The One[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_MATRONAE]The Matronae[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_COVEN]The Between[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_GREY_COUNCIL]The Grey Council[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_THE_ASHEN_VEIL]The Ashen Veil[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_EMBER_LEGION]The Ember Legion[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_ANOINTED]The Anointed[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_SONS_OF_DISCORD]The Sons of Discord[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_STEWARDS_OF_INEQUITY]The Stewards of Inequity[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_WHITE_HAND]The White Hand[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_COUNCIL_OF_ESUS]The Council of Esus[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_OCTOPUS_OVERLORDS]The Undertow[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_CULT_OF_THE_DRAGON]Cult of the Dragon[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_ETERNAL_CABAL]The Eternal Cabal[\LINK], and [LINK=RELIGION_FOXMEN]The Foxmen[\LINK]. It will be strengthened in Good lands and weakened in Evil lands. It will be strengthened by proximity to [LINK=BONUS_MANA_ENCHANTMENT]Enchantment Mana[\LINK], the [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_CLOCKWORK_CITY]Clockwork City[\LINK], [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_WORKSHOP]Workshops[\LINK], [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_CITADEL]Citadels[\LINK], or [LINK=FEATURE_HALLOWED_GROUND]Hallowed Ground[\LINK]. It is weakened by [LINK=BONUS_MANA_DIMENSIONAL]Dimensional Mana[\LINK], the [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_TAPESTRY_HOUSE]Tapestry House[\LINK], and [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_PORTAL]Portals[\LINK].

The church of Bhall has little long-lasting structure. Instead religious upheavals happen and huge masses of fanatical followers rise up and rebel against whatever is being protested in that area. The cause is less important than the fervor, the blessing of Bhall, and the violence that comes with the rebellion. Most worshipers of Bhall receive a brand of her mark that forever burns and inflicts pain. Bhall is also known as the Queen of Fire and the Fallen Star.


[PARAGRAPH][ICON_BULLET]Priests and Demons of  [LINK=RELIGION_EMBER_LEGION]The Ember Legion[\LINK] will have their ardas most strengthened by the influence of [LINK=RELIGION_EMBER_LEGION]The Ember Legion[\LINK], but also strengthened to a lesser degree by [LINK=RELIGION_THE_ASHEN_VEIL]The Ashen Veil[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_SONS_OF_DISCORD]The Sons of Discord[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_COVEN]The Between[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_ANOINTED]The Anointed[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_STEWARDS_OF_INEQUITY]The Stewards of Inequity[\LINK], and [LINK=RELIGION_COUNCIL_OF_ESUS]The Council of Esus[\LINK]. Its arda will be weakened by [LINK=RELIGION_CHILDREN_OF_THE_ONE]The Children of The One[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_MATRONAE]The Matronae[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_OCTOPUS_OVERLORDS]The Undertow[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_BROTHERHOOD_OF_WARDENS]The Brotherhood of Wardens[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_THE_EMPYREAN]The Empyrean[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_GREY_COUNCIL]The Grey Council[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_HOUSE_OF_PLENTY]The House of Plenty[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_UNBLEMISHED]The Unblemished[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_RINGGIVER]The Ringgivers[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_THE_EMPYREAN]The Order[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_CULT_OF_THE_DRAGON]Cult of the Dragon[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_LAERAN_CORD]The Laeran Cord[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_ETERNAL_CABAL]The Eternal Cabal[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_WHITE_HAND]The White Hand[\LINK], the [LINK=RELIGION_RUNES_OF_KILMORPH]The Runes of Kilmorph[\LINK], and [LINK=RELIGION_FELLOWSHIP_OF_LEAVES]The Fellowship of the Leaves[\LINK]. It will be weakened in Neutral and strengthened in Evil lands. It will be strengthened by proximity to [LINK=BONUS_MANA_FIRE]Fire Mana[\LINK] and weakened by [LINK=BONUS_MANA_WATER]Water Mana[\LINK]. It is strenthened near the [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_PYRE_OF_THE_SERAPHIC]Pyre of the Seraphic[\LINK], [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_HELLFIRE]Hellfire[\LINK], [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_PIT]Pits of Torment[\LINK], [LINK=TERRAIN_BURNING_SANDS]Burning Sands[\LINK], [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_SMOKE]Smoke[\LINK], [LINK=FEATURE_FLAMES]Flames[\LINK], [LINK=FEATURE_FOREST_BURNT]Burnt Forests[\LINK], [LINK=FEATURE_JUNGLE]Jungles[\LINK], and [LINK=FEATURE_TORMENTED_SOULS]Tormented Souls[\LINK], and weakened on [LINK=FEATURE_HALLOWED_GROUND]Hallowed Ground[\LINK].

Arawn pays no attention to creation, occupying himself with the matters of the afterworld instead. Despite this some few choose to worship him, though it is as useful as worshiping a rock. Often called the Unhearing God because he ignores his worshipers.

It will be strengthened by proximity to [LINK=BONUS_MANA_DEATH]Death Mana[\LINK], the [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_YGGDRASIL]Yggdrasil[\LINK], the [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_BRADELINES_WELL]Bradeline's Well[\LINK], [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_GRAVEYARD]Graveyards[\LINK], [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_BROKEN_SEPULCHUR]the Broken Sepulchur[\LINK], or [LINK=FEATURE_HALLOWED_GROUND]Hallowed Ground[\LINK]. It is weakened by [LINK=BONUS_MANA_LIFE]Life Mana[\LINK].
